title: Predicting place of delivery choice among childbearing women in East Africa: a comparative analysis of advanced machine learning techniques.
summary: Using survey data from 86,009 women in East Africa, tuned SVM/CatBoost models classified facility versus home delivery and association-rule mining identified covariates; this is an observational population-prediction result, not causal evidence for the recommended interventions. The full text confirms survey design, the 86,009 analytic cohort, model comparisons and association-rule results.
